related.title: RFC 3227：揮發證據的截止時間排程與可保存範圍
related.titleEn: RFC 3227: deadline scheduling for volatile evidence preservation
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：提交time-bounds.csv、precedence.json、原始時間字串及unknown-order.md；讓另一位學徒重算每個上界與下界。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver time-bounds.csv, precedence.json, original timestamp strings and unknown-order.md. A second apprentice must be able to recompute both endpoints and identify every deliberately unresolved pair.
related.difference: 以合成工作表比較兩種非搶占排程，分別記錄開始、完成、截止與遲到狀態；所有動作只模擬檔案保存，不讀取真實記憶體。
related.differenceEn: Compare two nonpreemptive schedules using a synthetic worksheet. Record start, completion, deadline and lateness for each task; simulate preservation with local fixtures without reading real memory or collecting live credentials.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: RFC 3339規範時間表示；此課的有界時鐘誤差模型是教學假設。字串轉UTC不會消除時鐘偏移，排序結果也不是因果證明。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 A事件名義100秒、界限±2秒；B名義107秒、界限±3秒。輸入CSV保留raw_time、normalized_time、bound、clock_source與原始列雜湊。 A最晚102、B最早104，安全間隙104−102=2秒；演算法檢查區間而非相減名義時間107−100。

RFC 3227強調揮發性與記錄保存流程；本例採單一工作者、已知時間、互不相依的簡化模型，非通用現場鑑識排程最佳化證明。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 工作A用時2分鐘截止3，B用時4截止8，C用時1截止10；從0開始；每個完成時間等於開始加用時。 A-B-C完成於2、6、7，三份及時；B-A-C完成於4、6、7，A超過截止3分鐘，只有兩份及時。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: RFC 3339 specifies timestamp representation. Bounded clock error is an explicit teaching assumption here; converting a string to UTC removes neither clock offset nor uncertainty, and sorting alone cannot establish causation. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Event A has nominal time 100 seconds with a ±2-second bound; B has time 107 with ±3 seconds. Preserve raw_time, normalized_time, bound, clock_source and an original-row hash in CSV. A can occur as late as 102; B can occur as early as 104. The guaranteed separation is 104−102=2 seconds. Compare intervals rather than simply subtracting nominal timestamps.

RFC 3227 emphasizes volatility and documented collection. This exercise assumes one worker, known durations and independent tasks; its schedule comparison is not a universal optimization claim for live forensic acquisition. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Task A lasts two minutes and expires at minute 3; B lasts four and expires at 8; C lasts one and expires at 10. Start at zero and compute completion from start plus duration. The A-B-C order completes at 2, 6 and 7, preserving all three on time. B-A-C completes at 4, 6 and 7; A misses its deadline by three minutes, leaving two timely acquisitions.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Kubernetes Audit：多階段請求關聯與截斷缺口
related.titleEn: Kubernetes Audit: multistage request correlation and truncation gaps
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：提交time-bounds.csv、precedence.json、原始時間字串及unknown-order.md；讓另一位學徒重算每個上界與下界。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver time-bounds.csv, precedence.json, original timestamp strings and unknown-order.md. A second apprentice must be able to recompute both endpoints and identify every deliberately unresolved pair.
related.difference: 以auditID關聯階段，保留stage、requestURI、時間與回應狀態；列出請求數、記錄列數及未觀測完成狀態的請求集合。
related.differenceEn: Correlate stages by auditID while preserving stage, requestURI, timestamps and response status. Report request count, log-row count and the set of requests whose completion state was not observed.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: RFC 3339規範時間表示；此課的有界時鐘誤差模型是教學假設。字串轉UTC不會消除時鐘偏移，排序結果也不是因果證明。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 A事件名義100秒、界限±2秒；B名義107秒、界限±3秒。輸入CSV保留raw_time、normalized_time、bound、clock_source與原始列雜湊。 A最晚102、B最早104，安全間隙104−102=2秒；演算法檢查區間而非相減名義時間107−100。

Kubernetes稽核政策可選事件層級及省略階段；缺少ResponseComplete不能單獨證明請求失敗，也可能是政策、長連線或收集缺口。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 100個請求ID：80個各有Received與Complete兩列、10個只有Received、10個只有Complete；合計180列，Complete可觀測90個。 請求身份為100而非180；完成階段可觀測率90/100=90%，不是API成功率，因為尚未查看回應狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: RFC 3339 specifies timestamp representation. Bounded clock error is an explicit teaching assumption here; converting a string to UTC removes neither clock offset nor uncertainty, and sorting alone cannot establish causation. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Event A has nominal time 100 seconds with a ±2-second bound; B has time 107 with ±3 seconds. Preserve raw_time, normalized_time, bound, clock_source and an original-row hash in CSV. A can occur as late as 102; B can occur as early as 104. The guaranteed separation is 104−102=2 seconds. Compare intervals rather than simply subtracting nominal timestamps.

Kubernetes audit policy selects levels and may omit stages. A missing ResponseComplete record alone does not prove request failure; policy choices, long-running requests and collection gaps are alternative explanations. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. One hundred request identities contain eighty Received/Complete pairs, ten Received-only records and ten Complete-only records. There are 180 rows and ninety identities with an observed completion record. Request identity count is 100 rather than 180. Completion-stage observability is 90/100=90%; this is not the API success rate because response-status outcomes have not yet been evaluated.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
